projects.title: LAMCAP – Offline Multi-Agent CLI Automation
projects.tagline: Privacy-first, multi-agent CLI automation framework with local LLM inference, persistent context and conference-paper results.
projects.problem: Most AI automation relies on cloud APIs and lacks persistent context, which is a problem for privacy-sensitive environments. LAMCAP explores how far we can push fully local, multi-agent automation with strong safety controls.
built: Multi-agent CLI automation framework (team of 4) with Planner, Executor and Validator agents coordinated via Python asyncio.
Persistent SQLite context store aggregating command history, filesystem state, environment variables and a task knowledge graph.
Local LLM inference via Ollama using qwen2.5-coder-7b (4-bit GGUF quantization), plus a JSON-based safety engine (BLOCK/WARN/PASS) and recency-plus-relevance context retrieval algorithm.
Achieved 87% single-command accuracy, 79% multi-step workflow success and 91% context retention at ~2.3s average latency, co-authored as a conference paper.
projects.outcome: Shows I can design and evaluate real multi-agent systems with measurable performance, strong privacy and safety.

projects.title: Zoo Guide Agent – RAG Conversational AI
projects.tagline: RAG-powered "Zoo Tour Guide" agent using Google ADK, Gemini 2.5 Flash and live Wikipedia lookups.
projects.problem: Visitors want rich, accurate explanations about animals and exhibits, but static signage cannot adapt to their questions. This project explores conversational, RAG-based guidance for a zoo context.
built: Conversational AI agent built during Google's Gen AI Academy (Hack2Skill APAC) using Google ADK and Gemini 2.5 Flash.
Live, real-time Wikipedia lookups via LangChain's tools to ground responses in current, factual information.
Multi-agent pipeline: Researcher Agent for querying and extracting facts, Formatter Agent for rewriting them into visitor-friendly explanations, orchestrated with transfer_to_agent.
Containerized with Docker and deployed on Google Cloud Run, supporting multi-turn context, session management and token streaming.
projects.outcome: Demonstrates practical RAG design, multi-agent orchestration and cloud deployment with a concrete, easy-to-understand use case.

projects.title: Text Summarization Agent – Configurable LLM API
projects.tagline: Gemini-powered summarization agent with three output styles and tool-calling architecture.
projects.problem: Different users need different summary styles (short bullets vs detailed reports); generic "summarize" endpoints are too rigid. This project builds a flexible, production-style summarization service.
built: AI agent using Google ADK Gemini API with three configurable styles: concise, bullet, and detailed summaries.
Tool-calling architecture with a custom `summarize_text` tool for structured, consistent output formatting.
Deployed on Google Cloud Run with support for multi-turn interactions and streaming responses for better UX.
Public GitHub repo and live endpoint, showing real API design, LLM integration and cloud deployment.
projects.outcome: Highlights my ability to design modular LLM services with controllable behavior and real deployment pipelines.

projects.title: CarbonPulse – Carbon Footprint Awareness PWA
projects.tagline: Zero-backend React PWA for real-time carbon footprint tracking and gamified reduction insights.
projects.problem: Individuals often don't know the impact of daily choices on their carbon footprint. CarbonPulse provides a privacy-first, interactive way to estimate and reduce emissions.
built: React Progressive Web App that calculates real-time personal carbon footprint with scenario-based inputs.
Emission factors sourced from UK DEFRA 2023 and US EPA/NREL to estimate impact across transport, energy and lifestyle.
Effort-vs-Impact recommendation engine to highlight high-impact, realistic actions users can take.
Zero-backend architecture with strict CSP headers, DOMPurify XSS sanitization, zero PII storage and deployment on Google Cloud Run.
projects.outcome: Shows full-stack thinking across UX, environmental data, security and deployment, with a meaningful social impact angle.

projects.title: SaaS Subscription Analytics – End-to-End Data Pipeline & Power BI
projects.tagline: End-to-end SaaS analytics pipeline from Kaggle CSVs to a PostgreSQL warehouse and a 4-page Power BI dashboard for subscription business KPIs.
projects.problem: Modern SaaS businesses need a reliable analytics stack to track MRR, churn and unit economics, but most "portfolio" projects stop at a single dashboard. In this project, I built an end-to-end pipeline that turns raw CSV exports into a production-style data warehouse and executive-ready analytics for a subscription product.
built: Python ETL pipeline ingesting Kaggle SaaS metrics CSV data into PostgreSQL, transforming it into raw tables, 3+ dimension tables and 2+ fact tables plus analytics views.
Star-schema data model for customers, subscriptions and revenue, powering 10+ SaaS KPIs: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), churn rate, CAC payback months, ARPU, customer tenure, active customers.
4-page Power BI experience: Executive Overview, Revenue & Plan Analytics, Churn & Retention, Customer Economics, built on a semantic model with relationships and hierarchies.
14+ DAX measures, a custom dark navy/cyan-purple theme, drill-through interactions and slicers by plan, time and segment to highlight growth, risk cohorts and high-value customers.
projects.outcome: This project shows I can design data models, build ETL, write analytical SQL, and design BI dashboards that decision-makers can actually use, not just academic plots.

projects.title: India Crude Oil Intelligence Dashboard (Microsoft Elevate Capstone)
projects.tagline: 4-page Power BI dashboard on India's crude oil import dependency (FY2014–FY2025) using real PPAC and NITI Aayog data.
projects.problem: India is heavily dependent on imported crude oil, and energy security requires understanding how dependency and supplier mix evolve over time. This capstone, built under the Microsoft Elevate × AICTE program, turns raw government data into an executive-friendly view of import dependency and refinery utilization.
built: Interactive 4-page Power BI dashboard analyzing crude oil imports from FY2014–FY2025 with official PPAC data.
Star schema across 6 interconnected tables (~300 records) capturing countries, volumes, years, dependency metrics and refinery information.
10+ DAX measures: Import Dependency %, YoY Growth, Country Share %, trend indicators and contribution metrics.

Visuals for refinery utilization across 23 refineries (258 MMTPA capacity) and petroleum stock levels, plus country-wise supply diversification including Russia's rise as India's #2 supplier post-2022.
projects.outcome: Surfaced India's ~89.2% crude import dependency and visualized how Russia's share increased after 2022, demonstrating ability to turn public policy data into clear energy insights.

projects.title: HR Analytics Dashboard – Microsoft Elevate Internship
projects.tagline: Power BI dashboard analyzing salary, attendance and workforce distribution with actionable HR insights.
projects.problem: HR teams need clear visibility into attendance, compensation patterns and workforce diversity to drive interventions. This project converts raw HR data into an interactive dashboard that surfaces gaps and managerial issues.
built: Power BI dashboard built during the Microsoft Elevate Power BI internship focusing on salary, attendance and workforce distribution analytics.
KPI cards, scatter plots (bonus vs salary), treemaps (job levels), donut charts (gender split) and tabular views for HR metrics.
DAX measures and Power Query transformations to clean HR data and compute attendance rate, bonus ratios and diversity indicators.
Identified a 13.16% attendance gap traceable to specific managers, demonstrating real, actionable insight rather than purely academic visuals.
projects.outcome: Shows my ability to turn messy HR data into business-ready dashboards that highlight where leaders need to take action.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction Web App (Pure Python ML)
projects.tagline: End-to-end churn prediction web app with a custom logistic-style engine, explainable outputs and retention recommendations.
projects.problem: Subscription businesses lose revenue when high-value customers churn; they need models that are explainable, not just black-box ML. This project demonstrates how I can build an interpretable risk model and deploy it as a usable web tool.
built: End-to-end churn prediction web application with input validation, feature engineering, risk scoring and recommended actions.
Custom logistic-style prediction engine in pure Python (manual sigmoid, interpretable feature weights) with no external ML libraries.
Features derived from tenure, monthly charges, contract type, service usage and satisfaction score; outputs include risk probability, main risk factors and suggested retention actions.
Responsive UI built with Bolt AI and a clear separation of frontend and backend for maintainability and future extension.
projects.outcome: Demonstrates that I can implement ML fundamentals from scratch, prioritize interpretability and ship a working application, not just a notebook.
